$comment: 0.x mode: while the major version is 0, the releaseRules below release a MINOR for a breaking change (feat!/fix! or a BREAKING CHANGE footer) instead of a major, so the line can evolve without a 1.0 promise. Delete the {"breaking": true} rule, and this comment, once the packages reach 1.0: from then on a breaking change must release a major again. CONTRIBUTING.md states the same rule for contributors. The conventionalcommits preset (installed by the shared workflow) is what makes a bare feat!:/fix!: count as breaking; the default angular preset does not parse the marker at all.

plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: if gh release view "v${nextRelease.version}" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "::error::Release v${nextRelease.version} already exists; releases are immutable."; exit 1; fi
plugins.prepareCmd: uv run --no-sync python scripts/set_version.py ${nextRelease.version} && uv lock && uv run --no-sync python scripts/verify_release_version.py v${nextRelease.version} && uv run --no-sync python scripts/build_wheels.py && uv run --no-sync python scripts/smoke_install_wheels.py && (cd dist && sha256sum *.whl > SHA256SUMS)
